thread:
Riley (CSM): quick capture from today's onboarding calls — three recurring asks across customers: 1) easier per-route billing visibility in console, 2) a one-click sample prompt for embeddings tests, 3) clearer retry behavior when dedicated capacity is momentarily throttled. Customers called out friction during trial and renewal conversations.

Jordan (Product PM): thanks Riley — do we have specific quotes or which customers hit the retry gap?

Riley (CSM): short notes: 
- Greenbridge: 'our billing team can't map line-items to routes' — wants CSV export or per-route toggle.
- Velociti (trial): wants sample prompt to quickly sanity-check embeddings quality before committing.
- NorthBay: saw 503s during short burst, not full outage but caused demo fail at renewal pitch. said "we couldn't explain why it retried or failed".

Priya (Customer Support): adding that support queue has 6 tickets referencing "route billing" this week. I've flagged 2 high-touch renewals where this is a blocker.

Sam (Onboarding Eng): for the retry behavior — current plan: we fall back to lower-tier model variant when capacity busy, but we don't surface that to the customer. Easy short-term fix: add an event in the console and a toast in SDK that shows fallback happened. Medium: per-request header with fallback reason.

Jordan (Product PM): prioritization ask: which of these moves needle on renewals/expansion fastest? My take: billing visibility -> high, retry visibility -> medium, sample prompt -> low-medium. Agree?

Riley (CSM): agree ranking. Billing visibility directly impacts finance teams and renewals.

Priya (Customer Support): +1. Also propose creating a short FAQ snippet for sales to surface temporary mitigation (how to interpret per-route charges) — immediate docs win.

Jordan (Product PM): OK action items — I'll scope quick-bake designs: 
1) Billing CSV export per-route (spike + 1 sprint for MVP)
2) SDK/console toast for fallback with link to docs (1 sprint)
3) Example embeddings prompt in docs + sample repo (backlog, priority after 1/2)

Sam (Onboarding Eng): I can prototype the fallback toast this week. For the CSV export I'll need account IDs mapping from infra — @mika-bot can you create a ticket?

mika-bot: Created issue CS-4129: "Per-route billing CSV export — capture mapping and UX" assigned to eng-billing. Link: https://tracker.example/CS-4129 :white_check_mark:

Riley (CSM): thx — I'll add affected customer list to the ticket and reach out to renewals owners. Would be helpful if product could share an expected ETA for the toast so I can tell customers.

Jordan (Product PM): ETA for toast prototype: PR by end of week, QA early next week. Will update CS-4129 and ping renewals owners.

Priya (Customer Support): I'll prepare a short sales-facing FAQ and a one-pager mitigation checklist (copyable email templates).

Riley (CSM): perfect. tagging for follow-ups: @Jordan (prod) @Sam (onboard) @Priya (support). Thanks all :thumbsup:

Sam (Onboarding Eng): small snippet for the toast we might use: ```json
{"event":"fallback","reason":"capacity_throttle","model_variant":"small-quant"}
```

Jordan (Product PM): nice, that helps. we'll aim to include that shape in the SDK telemetry too. closing loop later this week with customers who raised it.

Riley (CSM): I'll drop a short summary in the renewal playbook and update the affected accounts spreadsheet. If anything else surfaces in the next calls I'll append here.
